meta.structure: Three linked tables: projects (parent), packages (contractor slices), components (embedded equipment). See audit report for methodology.
meta.disclaimer: Compiled from public trade press, OEM/EPC press releases, and technical papers. Values and dates are as originally reported. Fields marked 'Not publicly disclosed' were deliberately left blank rather than estimated. Corrections from the user-provided workbook are identified as T4; the Hitachi award is user-provided and is not represented as publicly announced.

source_tiers.T1: Primary / official: the issuer, owner, contractor or OEM itself (press release, project page, filing)
source_tiers.T2: Trade press / project news (MEED, SaudiGulf Projects, Power Line, T&D World, etc.)
source_tiers.T3: Reference lists, technical literature, encyclopedic pages
source_tiers.T4: Internal / user-supplied lists (Sales / team lead / manager); not public
source_tiers.T5: Supplier log (component supplier records); not public

meta.source_policy: Every record cites sources. Confidence High needs a primary (T1) source or two independent T2 sources agreeing on the specific facts; Medium needs one reputable source; Low is a single weak or non-public source. Sources record tier, access date and how they were verified (new sources only).
meta.maturity_note: HVDC: In Operation, Under Installation, Awarded, Tendering, Planned / Announced. STATCOM/SVC: Awarded, Delivered, or Tendering for open opportunities. Other technologies retain their existing classifications.
